description: Direct inter-agent text that DIES ON ACK. Use for receipts, FYIs and short replies; use signal to point at a memory. send/check/ack. LOSABLE BY DESIGN: the first session of the recipient name to ack deletes it for every session of that name, an unacked message is deleted at expiry (default 7 days), and nothing is kept or searchable afterwards. Anything that must survive goes in memory_add plus signal. Requires text; memory_ids is refused.

action.description: send=post, check=read pending, ack=DELETE for every session of your name.

collection.description: send: shared collection (both parties must be members).

expires_hours.description: send: hours until the message is deleted unread, 24-720. Default 168.

recipient.description: send: agent name, email, or "owner" (the human account holder).

text.description: send: the message, up to 4000 characters.

name: message
